_about: How names and recurring terms are written in this language, for the website now and the game's .po files later. World names (characters, places, coins, canon fish) come from HusbandOutWorld content/i18n/zh/glossary.json: the series wins, so if a spelling there changes, change it here too. Game-only names (fish made for this game) are added here.
rule: Story names in Chinese characters chosen for sound (standard transliteration characters; feminine characters such as 丽/娅/莉 for women). This covers coined world terms too: creatures, plants, items, nari gels, spells, factions, guilds, places, ranks and coins (Wood People = 伍德皮普尔, Sapphire = 萨菲尔, Bleed Out = 布利德奥特). Multi-part personal names join with ·; one-word compound terms are written together. Japanese-origin names (Hiromi, Takeo, Yosuke…) use their usual kanji. Plain words are translated (Soul Tree = 索尔树, Nari Stones = 纳里石). The currency balls is 球 (萨菲尔球, 珀尔球), matching Japanese ボール; the unit timehunk stays in Latin letters. Real people (Deovandski, Mitsukiven, Feiourm), the title and pets named in the afterwords (Peeta, Fluffy, Maddog) stay in Latin letters.
